⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: The furnace inducer draft fan spins up, either no orange glow appears (cracked igniter) OR the burners light for 4 seconds and immediately shut back off (dirty/bad flame sensor), followed by flashing red LED codes through the sight glass.

Verified technical root cause: A cracked silicon nitride hot surface igniter (0130F00008S) prevents ignition, while an oxidized flame sensor rod (0130F00010) stops microamp flame rectification current.

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Turn off the furnace power switch and remove the upper burner access door.
  2. If the burners ignite for 3–4 seconds and shut off, pull the single 1/4-inch screw holding the 0130F00010 flame sensor rod and replace or lightly buff it.
  3. If the inducer fan runs for 30 seconds and you never see an orange glow before the gas clicks, inspect the 0130F00008S igniter tip for a white hairline crack and swap it out.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (1 / 3 / 4 Red LED Flashes (Ignition Lockout / Flame Sense))

Should I touch the black tip of the new 0130F00008S igniter with my bare fingers?
Avoid touching the silicon nitride heating tip with bare skin—finger oils can create a hot spot when the element reaches 2,500°F.
